cells.value: skids or modules, including flare systems, flare piping, and utility piping within modules.

A structural module usually enclosed with an exterior maximum width of 80 feet maximum length 200 feet long & 80 feet tall with a maximum weight of 3900 tons. Modules house mechanical, process, piping, electrical & instrumentation equipment & components. Sealift modules will be barged to Oliktok Dock then placed on SPMTs for the remaining land travel.

An enclosed structural module truckable normally from the Anchorage or Fairbanks area, with a maximum size of 20 feet wide by 80 feet long by 15.5 feet tall and a maximum weight of 100 tons. Truckable modules are designed to house the same components as Sea Lift Modules, however the components are smaller & fewer.
A PAU is defined as a Pre-Assembled Unit (in this case, normally pipe racks). Pipe racks are considered truckable modules (usually unhoused exterior pipe racks).
